annotations.title: Fetch a team, player, competition or match

description: Full details for an id from search: team:<id>, player:<id>, league:<league key> or match:<id>. Returns the title, the full text, and the football-mania.com url.

id.description: Typed id from search, e.g. team:9002, player:474972, league:EnglandPremierLeague, match:3868859

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

timezone.description: IANA time zone for kick-off times and dates, e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Riyadh. Default: UTC

name: fetch
